title: Spec-chapter, README, and wiki wrap-up
description:
Milestone 7 of the Local Store Initiative: the record matches the product. Chapter doc status sections current (src/spec/ch02_querying.rs), the stale "(specified next)" claim in src/lib.rs fixed, README status FAQ and mermaid "planned" labels flipped for what landed, a project wiki page documenting the store, and the board closed out for the landed epics. Per-task doc updates happen along the way (the docs-coverage guardrail: every .feature file embedded in a chapter); this epic is the final consolidation.

Work in your own worktree off origin/develop, PR to develop only — never main. Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Epic complete: every child task is closed; the work is merged to develop via PR #4 (fa32eb3).
